privileged_info_for_vlm: The target URL is https://crawler-test.com/. The expected export path is /home/ga/Documents/SEO/exports/uri_analysis.csv and the report path is /home/ga/Documents/SEO/reports/url_hygiene_report.txt. The CSV should contain at least 20 rows. The report must include: 1) Total URL count, 2) Count of URLs > 115 chars, 3) Count of URLs with uppercase or underscores, 4) Top 10 longest URLs, 5) Remediation recommendations. Crawler-test.com is designed to have many 'bad' URLs for testing purposes.
